title: DB-backed write-route policy registry with fail-closed runtime resolution

phases.objective: Persist route policy configuration in a versioned registry and resolve it read-only with deny-by-default behavior.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A valid staging shadow policy resolves, mismatched modes are denied, Production activation is denied, and a missing migration fails closed.
steps: Load a representative registry row through an injected query pool.
Normalize rollback, readback, approval, TTL, quota, lease, version, and hash fields without secrets.
Resolve a staging shadow policy and require an active, allowlisted, approval-bound result.
Reject a mode mismatch and reject Production activation even when a Production row exists.
Simulate a missing table and require the registry-not-migrated fail-closed result.
assertions: Database configuration is read through a parameterized query and never becomes authority by itself.
Production-live and production-canary cannot activate through the resolver.
Missing migration, missing policy, invalid mode, and mismatched environment fail closed.
No provider call, credential read, migration apply, database write, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Connect approved staging shadow policies to environment-bound readback and audit evidence without applying the migration automatically.
Prove optimistic locking, policy-version reconciliation, lease expiry, quota enforcement, and kill-switch behavior.
Production canary remains disabled until independent approval, route/resource allowlist, rollback rehearsal, and environment authorization exist.
Production-live remains disabled; this PR only adds configuration storage and read-only resolution.
